input.quote: 12.3 Additional Termination Rights by AbbVie. AbbVie may terminate this Agreement in its entirety, or on a country or other jurisdiction -by-country or other jurisdiction basis, for any or no reason, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Harpoon.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, minimum-fee-on-termination, or early-termination fee payable by AbbVie (our party). Targeted searches for "liquidated", "penalty", "termination fee", "forfeit" and "minimum" return nothing operative, and the termination architecture confirms it: AbbVie's convenience termination in Section 12.3 (p0590) is exercisable for any or no reason on 90 days' notice with no exit payment; Section 12.6/12.7 impose only reversion, transfer and licence-back consequences; Section 12.9 (p0634) merely preserves ordinary law and equity remedies rather than fixing a stipulated sum; and Section 12.10.1 continues Article 6 payments only for milestone events or Net Sales occurring before termination, i.e. accrued amounts. Section 6.10 (p0418) is a mutual, market-style default interest provision running against whichever Party pays late (including Harpoon), not a Customer-only penalty; the rate is redacted ([***]) but ordinary late-payment interest is not an LD deviation. Section 6.15 (p0424) further confirms the Agreement's stated terms fully define all consideration payable between the Parties. This sits at the preferred position — AbbVie pays no liquidated damages or penalties — so no redline is warranted; the fallback early-termination-fee cap is not needed because no such fee exists.
